assets.name: 星月
assets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Production transparent performance atlas for the SAME adult woman tarot dealer in the reference. Preserve her EXACT face, adult head-to-body proportions, hair, ivory blouse, emerald velvet dress, lighting, shoulder positions, VIEWER-RIGHT hand gripping the SAME moonstone staff, staff size and coordinates. Reference is a two-panel existing atlas. Output a NEW atlas with THREE equal square panels side by side (3:1 landscape), no labels or lines, genuine transparent alpha, same hip crop, position, scale and geometry in all three panels. Preserve realistic complete sleeve and wrist connections, natural cloth folds, healthy adult proportions. The staff arm stays at the exact reference grip position; do not wave or redesign the staff. Panel 3: eyes open looking warmly forward, very slight closed-mouth smile after completing magic; no teeth, no big grin; same body and both arm positions as panel 2. The three expressions must be visibly distinct yet subtle and natural. Keep all eyes, mouths and heads at consistent positions for local facial blending. No furniture, crystal ball, cards, beams, particles, background, baked glow halo, extra arms, disembodied hands, text or checkerboard. Refined cinematic painterly realism, same warm candle key light and faint cool fill.
